import re
text='aé😀bç🦊d'
p=re.compile(r'(?<=(..))(?=(..))|(?P<missing>Z)')
kept=list(p.finditer(text,2,6))
re.purge()
for m in reversed(kept):print(m.regs,m.groups(),m.span('missing'),m.pos,m.endpos)

import re
text='aé😀bç🦊d'
p=re.compile(r'(?<=(..))(.)')
kept=[]
def replace(m):
 kept.append(m)
 return m.group(2).upper()
print(p.sub(replace,text))
print([(m.regs,m.groups()) for m in reversed(kept)])

import re
text='aé😀bç🦊d'
p=re.compile(r'(?<=(..))')
for pos,endpos in [(7,7),(7,3),(4,6),(0,7)]:
 m=p.match(text,pos,endpos)
 print(None if m is None else (m.regs,m.pos,m.endpos,m.groups()))
